Setting a time range on a chart

You can configure the Time Range on a chart using pre-set options or by entering a custom range. The time range configuration is included in a chart file on Export or Save.
Prerequisites:
  • Chart view open in Workbench or browser
The following procedure describes how to set a custom time range on a chart.
Perform the following steps:
  1. In the Command Bar, click on the Time Range dropdown list and select the Time Range option.
  2. In the Time Range dialog Start time field, enter a specific start time using this format:
    yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss:sss
  3. If desired, click the End check box and enter a value for the end of the range.
     NOTE: Providing an End time is optional. Leaving it blank allows live data to continue plotting. 
  4. Click OK.
The Chart view updates immediately with the new time range.
